edition.title: NPNF Second Series, Volume VI: St. Jerome: Letters and Select Works

alternate_titles: St. Jerome: Letters and Select Works
work.author: Philip Schaff and Henry Wace
work.description: The sixth volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Jerome's letters, prefaces to the Vulgate books, and select treatises in English. Its container identity remains distinct from Jerome's works and the translated editions printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Volume VI
